email._note: Leave from_email/to_email/password blank and set GMAIL_USER / GMAIL_APP_PASS in a local .env file instead - see .env.example. config.json is the file people paste into chats, screenshots and repos, so it's the wrong place for a real email address or app password.

telegram._note: Leave these blank and set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in .env instead - see .env.example. (Also: the original code read notifications.telegram_token at the top level, which doesn't exist here - it's nested under notifications.telegram - so Telegram alerts silently never fired even when this was filled in. Fixed in job_auto_apply.py.)

apply._note: JobsDB auto-apply. enabled=false: this feature never runs at all (default). enabled=true + dry_run=true: walks the full apply flow (login, open job, open apply form) and stops right before the final Submit click - screenshots+logs what would have been submitted instead. enabled=true + dry_run=false: actually submits, capped at max_applications_per_run per run. Requires JOBDB_EMAIL / JOBDB_PASSWORD in .env - see .env.example.
